skills.summary: Build a vocabulary list that sticks
skills.job: Choose the most useful words for the learner's goal and level and give each with context, forms and a way to review.
gotchas: Too many new words per session

skills.summary: Explain a grammar point with examples
skills.job: Explain one grammar point of a target language in simple terms with contrast examples and short drills.
triggers: when do I use the subjunctive
why is this sentence like that
gotchas: Explaining with terms the learner lacks

skills.summary: Practise free conversation with gentle fixes
skills.job: Hold a conversation in the target language at the learner's level and correct mistakes in a separate, short note.

skills.summary: Explain how to pronounce words and sounds
skills.job: Describe how to say a word or sound in a target language, with comparisons, common errors and minimal pairs.
gotchas: Using respelling that only works in one accent
Claiming a sound exists in the learner's language when it does not

skills.summary: Correct writing and explain each fix
skills.job: Correct a learner's text in the target language and give the reason and rule for each change.

skills.summary: Write a short text at your level
skills.job: Write a short original text at the learner's level with glossed words and comprehension questions.
triggers: write me a story at my level
give me something to read in German

skills.summary: Spot false friends between two languages
skills.job: List and explain words that look alike in two languages but differ in meaning, with safe alternatives.
triggers: words that look the same but differ
gotchas: No example sentence for either side

skills.job: Explain an idiom or set phrase, its real meaning, register, origin if known and a natural equivalent.
gotchas: Missing that the idiom is dated or regional

skills.summary: Plan daily immersion in a language
skills.job: Design a realistic weekly immersion routine mixing listening, reading, speaking and writing around the learner's time.
Prepare the phrases, replies and etiquette for one situation such as ordering food or a doctor visit abroad, with pronunciation cues.
triggers: what to say at a restaurant
prepare me for a hotel check-in
gotchas: Stiff phrases locals do not use
Ignoring politeness norms of the place

skills.summary: Simplify a text for a learner
skills.job: Rewrite a text in the same language at a lower level, keeping the meaning and listing what was changed.
Run a short conjugation drill on chosen verbs and tenses, checking each answer and explaining the pattern.

skills.summary: Write messages for a language partner
skills.job: Help draft and read messages with a language exchange partner, with natural phrasing and corrections they can reuse.
triggers: how do I reply to this message
gotchas: Text too perfect to sound like the learner
Over-formal tone for a casual chat
Not offering to teach back in return

skills.job: Turn subtitles or a transcript of a show or video into a study sheet with vocabulary, phrases and listening tasks.
triggers: make a lesson from this video
gotchas: Slang and dialect treated as standard

skills.job: Review a translated text or interface strings for fit in the target locale: tone, units, dates, length and culture.
gotchas: Checking words and missing format conventions

skills.job: Decide and apply the right level of formality in a target language for a given person and situation.
triggers: should I use tu or usted
gotchas: Applying one rule to all regions
Forgetting the learner's relationship to the reader
